C1529.title: Conning the Crypto Conman: End-to-End Analysis of Cryptocurrency-Based Technical Support Scams
C1529.summary: A research paper presented at the IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy that analyzes cryptocurrency-based technical support scams. Scammers use Twitter as an initial contact point, then redirect victims to platforms like Telegram to complete the fraud, including tricking victims into revealing private keys or transferring funds to scam wallets.
